{{Top|leg}}
The '''droid toxin emitter''' was a utility item in the form of a small canister that fit under a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] [[Droid armor|plating]] and released a small cloud of [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] gas when activated. This had the effect of poisoning and paralyzing organics for a short period of [[Time/Legends|time]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
